review_evidence: The README defines AutoGeneralization as a command/linter that finds weaker kernel-checked type-class assumptions for existing Lean theorems and offers code actions that insert generalized statements.

Production modules under AutoGeneralization implement meta-level theorem analysis, evidence graphs, proposal selection, validation, pretty-printing, commands, and a linter; a declaration scan finds no theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations there.

All 92 declared theorem/lemma/axiom/example statements occur under AutoGeneralizationTest and serve as fixtures for command, linter, import, recoverability, and validation behavior, analogous to other proof-tool regression workloads excluded under COPY-005.

source_action.content_invariant: The repository is Lean metaprogramming/proof-refactoring infrastructure plus theorem-shaped regression fixtures; it has no independent mathematical or verified-semantics formalization corpus.
